sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B: Open-Source Reasoning LLM
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B is an 8.2B parameter open-source LLM distilled from DeepSeek-R1's reasoning capabilities into Qwen3's base model. It achieves strong performance on mathematics and coding benchmarks (AIME 2024: 86.0%, LiveCodeBench: 60.5%) while maintaining a compact footprint suitable for local deployment. MIT-licensed, ungated, and available on HuggingFace.

sources.title: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B — Free AI Model & API
sources.snippet: DeepSeek R1 0528 distilled to Qwen3 8B, available free on SiliconFlow's API. A compact reasoning model combining DeepSeek's chain-of-thought training with Qwen3's efficient 8B architecture — suitable for lightweight math and logic tasks. 33K context, 16K output. SiliconFlow's API is OpenAI-compatible with strong low-latency performance in China. Free tier requires registration.
